d:
Explore Package-06 of the Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor through detailed visuals of this major highway development project in Odisha.
The video takes you along the 45.5 km section of NH-130CD, covering the alignment from Design Chainage 293+000 to 338+500. Experience the expressway from a unique perspective with road-level views and drone footage highlighting the surrounding landscape & highway infrastructure.
Project Information
Project: Raipur–Visakhapatnam Economic Corridor
Package: OD-06
Location: Odisha, India
Highway: NH-130CD
Length: 45.5 km
